overview: Shree Balaji AI is a premium SaaS platform for AI-powered voice agents that help real estate and other businesses qualify leads, manage calls, schedule appointments, and track performance — all from a modern, responsive dashboard.
features: AI Voice Agent management with templates for Real Estate, Salon, Clinic, Gym, and more
Lead CRM with kanban pipeline, customer profiles, notes, and follow-up reminders
Call logs with transcript snippets, filters, and status tracking
Analytics dashboard with KPI cards, agent status, and upcoming appointments
Business onboarding wizard with logo upload and AI personality configuration
Subscription pricing page with Free, Basic, Pro, and Enterprise plans
Premium dark/light mode UI with glassmorphism cards and smooth animations
Fully mobile-responsive layout with Internet Identity authentication
